description: Flux GitOps repo preset. Extend with "github>vaughnw128/hakoniwa:flux" after the base preset. Repos set their own managerFilePatterns for flux and kubernetes.

customManagers.description: Flux distribution version in a FluxInstance

packageRules.description: HelmRelease chart and Kubernetes manifest updates deploy straight to the cluster: they are chore(deps), not releases.
Flux and the Flux operator are the control plane: review them, never automerge.
Charts and images built by hakoniwa are pinned by hakoniwa's Flux PRs, not by Renovate.
